integrations.name: Agent Skills
integrations.summary: A source catalog and installer for portable agent skills.

writes: Chosen skill files in an agent-specific project or user directory, including replacement or removal of an existing installation

details: Install and diff explicitly selected skills
Update can replace an installed skill directory; uninstall removes it

confirmation.notes: Review the selected skill, destination, diff, and local modifications before installation, replacement, or removal.

integrations.health_check: Use the repository's documented diff and validation workflow for the selected skill.
integrations.uninstall: Remove only the installed skill directory after reviewing local modifications.

integrations.name: Agent Workspace
integrations.summary: A slim standalone package for agent lifecycle, state, reconciliation, and recovery workflows.

prerequisites: A repository where workspace state may be stored

reads: Local workspace state, sessions, branches, and worktrees
writes: Local workspace state and session files after workflow approval
Optional removal of explicitly approved stale worktrees or branches

confirmation.notes: Recovery is read-only by default; require approval before cleanup or state mutation.

integrations.health_check: Run the package's documented validation and a read-only start or reconcile workflow.
integrations.uninstall: Remove the installed adapters only after preserving any workspace state the user wants to keep.

integrations.name: AI Tools for Creators
integrations.summary: A discovery catalog for creator skills, MCP servers, benchmarks, and publishing tools.

details: Discovery links only; every linked tool needs separate review

confirmation.notes: A listing is not verification. Re-check the linked source before installing or authorizing it.

integrations.health_check: Open the linked project's current source and verify its own installation and safety claims.
integrations.uninstall: No installation is performed by this catalog entry.

integrations.name: Substack MCP
integrations.summary: An MCP server for reading Substack publication data, managing private drafts, and publishing short-form Notes.

reads: Subscriber count, posts, drafts, comments, sections, analytics, and schedules

details: No long-form publish, delete, or schedule mutation
Note creation publishes immediately and has no server-side undo

confirmation.notes: Always confirm Note creation as an immediate public publish action; private draft writes use the normal external-write gate.

integrations.health_check: After explicit authentication, run the documented subscriber-count read and verify the expected publication account.
integrations.uninstall: Remove the MCP client entry and, if used, review then remove the local browser-login session file.
